d: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi addressed the INDIA bloc's protest at Delhi's Ramlila Maidan, accusing the Election Commission of facilitating vote theft and undermining democracy. Alleging that 13.5 crore voters were removed from electoral rolls after the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Gandhi demanded the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and predicted that he would face legal action.
